title: Efficient spin-lattice dynamics and spin thermometry with machine-learned magnetic potentials
title_zh: 利用机器学习的磁势进行高效的自旋晶格动力学和自旋测温
summary: 在有限温度自旋晶格动力学中，传统的仅受力自旋温度计因每次自旋中的能量非线性而失效，而标准半隐式 SIB 积分器每步需要两次模型评估。在这里，我们引入了一种几何探针自旋温度，该温度对于仅使用一阶自旋力而不使用 Hessians 的任意高阶平滑哈密顿量来说是精确的，使其自然适合非线性多体机器学习 (ML) 磁势。作为补充，我们的缓存字段积分器 (CFI) 通过每步进行单个模型评估来保持二阶精度，大约可利用 ML 潜力将每步时间减半。
abstract: arXiv:2611.32129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In finite-temperature spin-lattice dynamics, conventional force-only spin thermometers fail for energies nonlinear in each spin, while the standard semi-implicit SIB integrator requires two model evaluations per step. Here we introduce a geometric-probe spin temperature that is exact for arbitrary high-order smooth Hamiltonians using first-order spin forces alone without Hessians, making it naturally suited for nonlinear many-body machine-learning (ML) magnetic potentials. Complementarily, our cached-field integrator (CFI) stays second-order accurate with a single model evaluation per step, about halving the time per step with ML potentials. Extensive benchmarks against Monte Carlo across analytic and ML systems confirm both exact thermometry and accurate thermodynamics.

title: Parametric neural-network wavefunctions across a bosonic phase transition
title_zh: 玻色相变中的参数神经网络波函数
summary: 我们提出了 Boseformer，一种基于注意力的通用神经网络架构，用于用玻色量子统计表示粒子的波函数，包括超流体和晶相。该模型经过训练，生成波函数作为这些相之间量子相变的哈密顿参数的函数。一旦使用变分蒙特卡罗优化进行训练，它就可以作为描述相变的基础模型，而无需针对各个参数值对其进行重新训练。我们在具有 1/r3 排斥相互作用的二维玻色子系统上演示了我们的方法。
abstract: arXiv:2611.33150v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose Boseformer, a universal attention-based neural-network architecture for representing the wavefunctions of particles with bosonic quantum statistics, including superfluid and crystal phases. The model is trained to generate the wavefunction as a function of a Hamiltonian parameter across the quantum phase transition between these phases. Once trained with variational Monte Carlo optimization, it can serve as a foundation model describing the phase transition without the need to retrain it for individual parameter values. We demonstrate our method on a system of two-dimensional bosons with 1/r³ repulsive interaction.

title: Comparative Molecular Dynamics Study of Initial Oxide Film Growth on Al, Mg, and Ti Using a Universal Neural Network Potential
title_zh: 使用通用神经网络势对 Al、Mg 和 Ti 上初始氧化膜生长进行比较分子动力学研究
summary: 许多金属（例如铝和钛）会自发形成氧化膜，该氧化膜可能是钝化的。我们报告了使用通用神经网络势 (NNP) 通过分子动力学 (MD) 对三种主要轻结构金属 Al、Mg 和 Ti 上氧化膜形成的直接计算观察。在 MD 模拟过程中提供 O2 分子以补充金属消耗的 O2。在氧气压力为 102-103 atm 的情况下，Al 和 Ti 在模拟的几皮秒内形成了 1-2 nm 厚的薄膜。所有金属氧化物的薄膜厚度继续与模拟时间的对数成比例增加，与卡布雷拉-莫特理论一致。
abstract: arXiv:2611.32659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spontaneous formation of an oxide film, which may be passive, is found in many metals such as Al and Ti. We report direct computational observation of oxide film formation on the three major light structural metals, Al, Mg, and Ti, with molecular dynamics (MD) using a universal neural network potential (NNP). O2 molecules were supplied during MD simulations to replenish O consumed by the metal. Al and Ti formed a 1-2 nm thick film within a few ps of the simulation with O2 gas pressure of 102-103 atm. The film thicknesses of all metal oxides continued to increase proportionally to the logarithm of simulation time, consistent with Cabrera-Mott theory. Al and Ti oxides grow at the surface, while Mg oxide grows into the Mg metal. Al, Mg, and Ti are approximately 4.4, 4.3, and 5.2-fold coordinated, respectively, in the oxide.

title: OMNI-P3x universal neural network potential for large-scale computational photochemistry workflows
title_zh: OMNI-P3x 通用神经网络在大规模计算光化学工作流程中的潜力
summary: 计算光化学支持新材料的设计和理解。然而，激发态量子力学（QM）计算的高昂成本使得筛选大型分子库的成本过高。为了解决这一限制，我们引入了 OMNI-P3x，这是一种通用机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)，用于中性和带电有机分子的单线态基态和激发态模拟。它经过基态和激发态构象的训练，可以执行完整的计算光化学工作流程，精度接近 TD-DFT。
abstract: arXiv:2611.32133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computational photochemistry supports the design and understanding of new materials. However, the high cost of excited-state quantum-mechanical (QM) calculations makes screening large molecular libraries prohibitively expensive. To address this limitation, we introduce OMNI-P3x, a universal machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) for singlet ground- and excited-state simulations of neutral and charged organic molecules. Trained on both ground- and excited-state conformations, it performs complete computational photochemistry workflows with accuracy approaching TD-DFT. We demonstrate its practical applicability by screening a combinatorial library of 234,375 flavylium derivatives, where the pretrained model performs ground-state geometry optimization and predicts absorption properties without additional QM calculations. Following fine-tuning, we further screen 162,960 xanthene-based dyes, identifying new candidates for red, near-infrared and short-wavelength infrared emission. Furthermore, state-dependent neural charges, learned without reference atomic charges, provide an interpretable picture of intramolecular charge redistribution upon excitation.

title: Accelerating Equivariant Interatomic Potentials for Molecular Dynamics through Radial tabulation and Kernel Fusion
title_zh: 通过径向制表和核融合加速分子动力学的等变原子间势
summary: 等变机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 实现了接近量子化学的精度，但其计算成本和 GPU 内存占用限制了分子动力学 (MD) 在扩展长度和时间尺度上的发展。即使张量积 (TP) 加速，这两个瓶颈仍然是通过评估和存储 NequIP 卷积中的每边径向权重来控制的。我们引入了 JET-MLIP（用于 MLIP 模拟的带有列表径向权重的联合核等变卷积），这是一种适用于预训练 NequIP 系列势的 GPU 后端，无需重新训练。
abstract: arXiv:2611.31865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Equivariant machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) achieve near-quantum-chemical accuracy, but their computational cost and GPU memory footprint restrict molecular dynamics (MD) at extended length and time scales. Even when the tensor product (TP) is accelerated, both bottlenecks remain governed by evaluating and storing per-edge radial weights in the NequIP convolution. We introduce JET-MLIPs (Joint-Kernel Equivariant Convolution with Tabulated Radial Weights for MLIP simulation), a GPU backend applicable to pretrained NequIP-family potentials without retraining. JET-MLIPs replaces the radial multilayer perceptron (MLP) with a piecewise cubic Hermite table and fuses table lookup, spherical harmonics, TP and neighbor aggregation into a single kernel, eliminating per-edge radial-weight and MLP-intermediate storage during force evaluation. Across 15 released potentials from SevenNet, MACE, NequIP-OAM, Nequix and EquFlash on a 5632-atom liquid electrolyte, LAMMPS MD attains 1.5-5.9× step-time speed-ups and 2.4-24× peak memory reductions relative to each family's existing TP-accelerated backend on a single H200 GPU while preserving single-precision (fp32) accuracy and dynamical stability. These reductions enable multi-nanosecond transport-property simulations of roughly 10⁴-atom systems on a single GPU and broaden access to large-scale equivariant MLIP MD on widely available GPUs.

title: Neutron Spectroscopy Transformed: Deuterated ZIF-8 and Machine-Learned Potentials Catch Nitrogen Threading Its Gates
title_zh: 中子光谱学的变革：氘代 ZIF-8 和机器学习势捕获氮穿过它的大门
summary: 我们报告了通过将机器学习的原子间势 (MLIP) 与样品的有意氘化相结合，非弹性中子散射 (INS) 所揭示的内容发生了阶跃变化。 INS 在原位定量过程中绘制框架和多孔材料内客体运动方面的能力历来有一个警告：昂贵的密度泛函理论计算是分析速度和深度的主要瓶颈。我们表明，快速前沿 MLIP 在两个方面消除了这一瓶颈，与实验保持同步，同时带来了新的洞察力。氘化 ZIF-8 的连接体撬开氢框架中重叠的谱带，我们在 77 K 下针对八个阶段的氮剂量测试了 4 个 MLIP。
abstract: arXiv:2611.32739v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a step change in what inelastic neutron scattering (INS) can reveal, by combining machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) with deliberate deuteration of the sample. INS's prowess in charting framework and guest motions within porous materials during in situ dosing has historically had one caveat: costly density-functional-theory calculations are a major bottleneck in the speed and depth of analysis. We show that rapid frontier MLIPs remove this bottleneck on both counts, keeping pace with the experiment while bringing a new level of insight. Deuterating the linkers of ZIF-8 pries apart bands that overlap in the hydrogenous framework, and we test four MLIPs against eight stages of nitrogen dosing at 77 K. On loading, a previously unobserved band appears at 270 cm⁻¹ and grows gradually through the dosing series. The simulations trace it to single N2 molecules threaded end-on through four-ring windows, each turning its ring of linkers and propping the window open, and unbiased dynamics catch molecules threading into the windows on their own, finding a free-energy trap that crowding stabilizes. This is the first vibrational signature of the threaded state and, crucially, its intensity directly counts the threading over the slow, macroscopic timescale of gas uptake, in situ. More broadly, the simulations explain how each framework band responds to its guests, establishing MLIP-assisted inelastic neutron scattering as a route to mechanism, not just assignment.

title: A fermionic framework for quantum machine learning benchmarks
title_zh: 用于量子机器学习基准的费米子框架
summary: 我们提出了一个基于模拟自由费米子系统来构建和基准测试可扩展机器学习（ML）模型的框架。我们的费米子机器学习 (FermiML) 框架 (i) 用途广泛，足以涵盖核方法和神经网络，(ii) 适用于分类和回归，以及 (iii) 可扩展到现实世界的数据集。 FermiML 模型是量子电路，共享大多数量子 ML (QML) 模型的构建块：（参数化）量子位旋转和纠缠门。这使我们能够构建模拟任何 QML 模型的架构以及量子资源和归纳偏差的费米子代理，同时保持有效的经典可模拟性。
abstract: arXiv:2611.31458v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a framework for building and benchmarking scalable machine learning (ML) models based on simulating free-fermion systems. Our fermionic ML (FermiML) framework is (i) versatile enough to encompass kernel methods and neural networks, (ii) applicable to classification and regression, and (iii) scalable to real-world datasets. FermiML models are quantum circuits sharing the building blocks of most quantum ML (QML) models: (parameterized) qubit rotations and entangling gates. This allows us to build fermionic surrogates that mimic the architecture, and hence the quantum resources and inductive bias, of any QML model while remaining efficiently classically simulable. We thus benchmark QML models against close fermionic counterparts on equal footing and ascertain whether a purported QML gain truly stems from classically inaccessible resources or is an accidental side-effect. Across 31 configurations from five classification datasets, we benchmark quantum kitchen sinks (QKS), instantaneous quantum polynomial (IQP) and generic parameterized quantum circuit (PQC) models against fermionic surrogates. fQKS significantly outperforms QKS and is statistically indistinguishable from IQP and PQC; fPQC outperforms IQP and QKS and ties PQC in 28 configurations. We also introduce fermionic fidelity and Pfaffian covariance kernels for regression and establish QML baselines for this harder task. Finally, we introduce a fermionic energy-based classifier scalable to large text and image datasets, which outperforms prominent QML models on images, beats or closely trails them on text, and stays close to classical baselines throughout. Our results show that while performance depends sensitively on architecture, FermiML yields fermionic surrogates that challenge or outperform their unrestricted counterparts and fermionic QML models that match the scale of classical baselines on real-world datasets.

title: Nanoindentation induced plasticity in equiatomic MoTaW alloys by experimentally guided machine learning molecular dynamics simulations
title_zh: 通过实验引导的机器学习分子动力学模拟，纳米压痕诱导等原子 MoTaW 合金的塑性
summary: 难熔复合浓缩合金（RCCA）表现出卓越的强度和热稳定性，但其在复杂接触载荷下的塑性变形机制仍不清楚。在这里，通过实验和原子解析相结合的建模方法研究了等原子 MoTaW 合金的纳米压痕响应。球形纳米压痕实验与采用表格低维高斯近似势 (tabGAP) 的大规模分子动力学模拟相结合，可实现接近 DFT 的精度。通过载荷-位移曲线的主成分分析 (PCA) 实现的基于物理的相似性准则用于识别机械代表性的实验响应，以便与模拟进行定量比较。
abstract: arXiv:2601.06846v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Refractory complex concentrated alloys (RCCA) exhibit exceptional strength and thermal stability, yet their plastic deformation mechanisms under complex contact loading remain insufficiently understood. Here, the nanoindentation response of an equiatomic MoTaW alloy is investigated through a combined experimental and atomistically resolved modeling approach. Spherical nanoindentation experiments are coupled with large scale molecular dynamics simulations employing a tabulated low dimensional Gaussian Approximation Potential (tabGAP), enabling near DFT accuracy. A physics based similarity criterion, implemented via PCA of load-displacement curves, is used to identify mechanically representative experimental responses for quantitative comparison with simulations. Indentation stress-strain curves are constructed yielding excellent agreement in the elastic regime between experiment and simulation, with reduced Young's moduli of approximately 270 GPa. Generalized stacking fault energy calculations reveal elevated unstable stacking- and twinning-fault energies in MoTaW relative to pure refractory elements, indicating suppressed localized shear and a preference for dislocation-mediated plasticity. Atomistic analyses demonstrate a strong crystallographic dependence of plastic deformation, with symmetric 110<111> slip activation and four-fold rosette pile-ups for the [001] orientation, and anisotropic slip, strain localization, and enhanced junction formation for [011]. Local entropy and polyhedral template matching analyses further elucidate dislocation network evolution and deformation-induced local structural transformations. Overall, this study establishes a direct mechanistic link between fault energetics, orientation-dependent dislocation activity, and experimentally observed nanoindentation behavior in RCCA.

title: AI-assisted formal proofs for static and time-dependent density functional theory on lattices
title_zh: 人工智能辅助的格子静态和瞬态密度泛函理论的形式证明
summary: 霍恩伯格-科恩定理在晶格上失败，在晶格中，相差超过一个常数的两个势能共享一个基态。我们证明这种潜力是非凡的。我们考虑任何连接晶格上的无自旋费米子，在除空或满之外的任何填充下，具有公共符号的跳跃幅度和任何密度-密度相互作用。其基态与相差超过一个常数的电势共享的电势位于封闭的、无处密集的零勒贝格测度集中。非简并共享基态的密度形成一组至少为二的余维。关于势的陈述也适用于 Kohn-Sham 势和自旋密度泛函理论，其中磁场的均匀移动是唯一的附加自由度。
abstract: arXiv:2611.32370v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Hohenberg-Kohn theorem fails on lattices, where two potentials that differ by more than a constant can share a ground state. We prove that such potentials are exceptional. We consider spinless fermions on any connected lattice, at any filling other than empty or full, with hopping amplitudes of a common sign and any density-density interaction. The potentials whose ground state is shared with a potential differing by more than a constant lie in a closed, nowhere dense set of zero Lebesgue measure. The densities of non-degenerate shared ground states form a set of codimension at least two. The statement about the potentials also holds for the Kohn-Sham potential and for spin-density functional theory, where a uniform shift of the magnetic field is the only additional freedom. In time-dependent density functional theory on lattices, we show that not every ground state of a connected lattice can serve as the initial state of the density-potential map. A counterexample is the ground state of two fermions on a square that Penz and van Leeuwen found as a counterexample to the Hohenberg-Kohn theorem. For almost every static potential, however, every real ground state can serve as an initial state, also for spin-resolved densities. We also give formal proofs that the time-dependent Kohn-Sham potential exists, locally in time, for almost every static Kohn-Sham potential, and of known results: local existence and uniqueness of the time-dependent potential for an admissible initial state, continuation in time up to the boundary of the set of admissible states, and the convergence properties of a regularized Kohn-Sham iteration. All theorems and propositions are formalized in the proof assistant Lean 4 and checked by computer.

title: AI-Assisted Topological High-Harmonic Spectroscopy for Characterizing Crystal Symmetries and Nonlinear Responses
title_zh: 用于表征晶体对称性和非线性响应的人工智能辅助拓扑高次谐波光谱
summary: 结构光已成为探测非线性光与物质相互作用的独特工具。特别有趣的是它与各向异性介质（例如晶体材料）的相互作用，其各向异性响应编码有关其电子特性的信息。最近，拓扑高次谐波光谱作为一种全光学方法被引入，从谐波空间强度分布中提取石墨烯的各向异性非线性响应。在这里，拓扑高次谐波光谱与人工智能（AI）相结合，以检索原子薄材料的各向异性非线性响应和晶体对称性。卷积神经网络经过训练和验证，可以学习谐波远场强度分布与表现出不同旋转对称性的材料的非线性响应之间的逆映射。
abstract: arXiv:2611.32704v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structured light has emerged as a unique tool for probing nonlinear light-matter interactions. Particularly interesting is its interaction with anisotropic media, such as crystalline materials, whose anisotropic responses encode information about their electronic properties. Recently, topological high-harmonic spectroscopy was introduced as an all-optical approach to extract the anisotropic nonlinear response of graphene from harmonic spatial intensity profiles. Here, topological high-harmonic spectroscopy is combined with artificial intelligence (AI) to retrieve the anisotropic non-linear response and crystal symmetry of atomically thin materials. A convolutional neural network is trained and validated to learn the inverse mapping between harmonic far-field intensity profiles and the nonlinear response of materials exhibiting different rotational symmetries. Comparisons with microscopic high-harmonic-generation simulations demonstrate the accurate retrieval of distinct effective nonlinear responses in single-symmetry crystals, such as single-layer graphene and bilayer graphene with different stacking orders, and in crystals exhibiting multiple symmetry components, such as monolayer hexagonal boron nitride. Macroscopic high-harmonic-generation simulations assess the robustness and applicability limits of the technique. These results establish AI-assisted topological high-harmonic spectroscopy as a fast, contactless tool for characterizing nonlinear optical responses and crystal symmetries without phase-resolved measurements, opening prospects for applications to complex systems such as polycrystals and van der Waals heterostructures.

title: Compressible Representations: Functional Spines in Deep Neural Networks
title_zh: 可压缩表示：深度神经网络中的功能脊柱
summary: 深度网络将输入嵌入高维表示中，但这种容量有多少实际上驱动了行为？我们引入了一个框架，用于在每一层识别对任务功能敏感的表示子空间。使用类似于 Fisher 信息但在隐藏表示上定义的矩阵，我们根据方向对下游计算的影响对方向进行排名，并将其投影到对任务最敏感的子空间上。在预训练的视觉网络中，表示具有显着的可压缩性：任务敏感子空间的一小部分保留了大部分性能，通常需要比几何替代品少得多的维度。我们发现这种压缩表示对于整个网络上生成的对抗性攻击也更加鲁棒。
abstract: arXiv:2611.31817v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep networks embed inputs in high-dimensional representations, but how much of this capacity actually drives behavior? We introduce a framework for identifying, at each layer, the subspace of the representation that is functionally sensitive to the task. Using a matrix analogous to the Fisher information but defined over the hidden representation, we rank directions by their influence on downstream computation and project onto the most task-sensitive subspace. Across pretrained vision networks, representations are remarkably compressible: a small fraction of the task-sensitive subspace preserves most performance, often requiring far fewer dimensions than geometric alternatives. We find that this compressed representation is also more robust to adversarial attacks generated on the full network. We additionally show that this decomposition recovers functionally distinct subspaces within the same representation: on cue-conflict stimuli, shape-sensitive and texture-sensitive directions are largely non-overlapping, and ablating one selectively impairs the corresponding task while leaving the other intact. Task-sensitive subspaces also provide a principled foundation for continual learning: constraining gradient updates to lie orthogonal to the task-sensitive subspaces of prior tasks outperforms standard variance-based gradient projection methods. Finally, restricting representational comparisons to task-sensitive subspaces reveals that inter-model alignment is higher in task-sensitive directions than in task-insensitive directions at later layers, and that conditioning on different tasks over the same stimuli uncovers asymmetries that full-space similarity measures cannot detect. Together, these results establish that deep networks compute through a low-dimensional functional spine embedded within a much larger representational space.

title: Machine learning enables full Bayesian inference for spinning extreme-mass-ratio inspirals
title_zh: 机器学习可实现旋转极端质量比螺旋的完整贝叶斯推理
summary: 极端质量比螺旋体（EMRI）是一种恒星质量致密天体，螺旋进入大质量黑洞，有望测量中心黑洞的质量和自旋，揭示它们周围的强场环境，并通过毫赫兹引力波观测来测量宇宙距离。然而，大多数对这些系统的参数推断的预测都假设已知的源参数，并且广泛的先前分析仅解决了问题的简化版本。旋转源的所有 14 个参数与完整先验的联合反演仍未解决。在这里，我们针对增强分析拼凑模型解决了这个问题：生成网络缩小了完整的先验并揭示了退化自旋方向的环，并且确切的检测器似然确定了后验。
abstract: arXiv:2611.31916v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs), stellar-mass compact objects spiralling into massive black holes, promise to measure the masses and spins of the central black holes, reveal the strong-field environment around them and gauge cosmic distances via millihertz gravitational-wave observations. Yet most forecasts for the parameter inference of these systems assume known source parameters, and broad-prior analyses have addressed only simplified versions of the problem. The joint inversion of all 14 parameters of a spinning source from the complete prior has remained unsolved. Here we solve it for the augmented analytic kludge model: generative networks narrow the complete prior and reveal a ring of degenerate spin directions, and the exact detector likelihood determines the posterior. For a simulated one-year LISA-Taiji observation, within one ring sector we obtain, for the first time, a 14-parameter posterior of a spinning EMRI from the complete prior, the most precise yet obtained for such a source from broad priors. The redshifted mass and spin of the massive black hole are determined to two parts in 10⁵, the mass two orders of magnitude beyond any electromagnetic measurement. The compact object's redshifted mass is measured to one part in 10⁴, and its eccentric, retrograde orbit discriminates between capture channels. The 0.8% distance and sub-square-degree localization are sufficient for dark-siren cosmology. Year-long coherent analysis resolves the inspiral driven by radiation reaction itself.

title: Thermodynamics of complex crystals from a generalized mean-field bond model
title_zh: 来自广义平均场键模型的复杂晶体的热力学
summary: 我们将之前引入的平均场键模型从一元面心立方晶格扩展到具有多种化学物质和亚晶格的晶体，无需统计采样即可准确预测有限温度热力学。我们的概括根据晶体的威科夫位置重新表述了模型，用一个原子代表每个原子，并求解其每个相邻壳层的参考键的键密度。键-键相关函数是根据零温力常数构建的，允许晶体中每个键的偏差通过壳参考键的线性函数来表达。通过要求整个晶体具有单一维里温度以及平均键长与晶体体积的兼容性来增强热力学自一致性。
abstract: arXiv:2611.32609v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We extend our previously introduced mean-field bond model from unary fcc lattices to crystals with multiple chemical species and sublattices, accurately predicting finite-temperature thermodynamics without statistical sampling. Our generalization reformulates the model in terms of the Wyckoff positions of the crystal, representing each by one atom, and solving for the bond density of the reference bond of each of its neighbor shells. Bond-bond correlation functions are built from the zero-temperature force constants, allowing the deviation of every bond in the crystal to be expressed through linear functions of the reference bond of a shell. Thermodynamic self-consistency is enforced by requiring a single virial temperature for the whole crystal, and compatibility of average bond lengths with crystal volume. Model predictions are validated against molecular dynamics simulations of unary, binary, and ternary crystals using Morse-type bonding potentials, parametrized for each shell from the force constants of empirical interatomic potentials at several isotropic strains. In each case, the predicted bond densities and thermodynamics agree with the simulations to within their statistical uncertainty. We discuss strategies for combining the model with bonding potentials parametrized from first principles and foundation models to predict the finite-temperature thermodynamics of complex crystals at ab initio accuracy without statistical sampling.

title: Lattice in Line: Optimized DMRG ordering for complex lattice geometries
title_zh: Lattice in Line：针对复杂晶格几何结构的优化DMRG排序
summary: 密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）是一种一维张量网络技术，但它并不局限于一维系统：它可以应用于周期性二维和三维簇和分子，前提是它们的位点首先沿一条线枚举；这一步可以称为“晶格编译”。本文讨论了用于寻找这一最优枚举的三个代理损失函数：图带宽B（最大相互作用范围）、割宽C（穿过割集的边最大数目）和平均相互作用范围R。通过为受阻磁性中关注的大量簇构造哈密顿MPO（矩阵积算符），我发现C决定了峰值SU(2)海森堡MPO边维数，而R决定了平均边维数。按字典顺序针对(C,R)可得到最佳能量。
abstract: arXiv:2609.25384v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) is a one-dimensional tensor-network technique, but it is not limited to one-dimensional systems: it can be applied to periodic 2D and 3D clusters and molecules, provided their sites are first enumerated along a line; a step one may call ``lattice compilation''. This paper discusses three proxy loss functions for finding this optimal enumeration: the graph bandwidth B (maximum interaction range), the cutwidth C (maximum number of bonds crossing a cut), and the average interaction range R. Constructing the Hamiltonian MPO (matrix-product operator) for a large set of clusters that are of interest in frustrated magnetism, I find that C determines the peak SU(2) Heisenberg MPO bond dimension and R the average one. Targeting (C,R) lexicographically yields the best energies. Targeting B indirectly reduces C, but not as efficiently as targeting C directly. Otherwise, the value of B itself is largely irrelevant in the sense that good DMRG energies can have large B. To perform the optimization, classic heuristics (e.g. reverse Cuthill--McKee) prove unreliable even for small clusters, and I find that a QUBO formulation improves them only marginally. Instead I propose a staged optimization built on Boolean satisfiability (SAT) and constraint-programming (CP) solvers, CP-SAT of Google's OR-Tools (a hybrid of CP propagation and SAT clause learning) and the SAT solvers CaDiCaL and Glucose. This approach yields significantly better orderings together with rigorous bounds. The corresponding Lattice in Line code is available at https://github.com/spinflip/lattice_in_line and was designed with extensive use of the Fable 5 large language model.

title: Path-probability gradients for optimizing force fields against dynamical observables
title_zh: 针对动态可观测值优化力场的路径概率梯度
summary: 机器学习力场继承了用于生成训练数据的电子结构方法的误差，并根据实验测量对其进行改进，提供了超越此限制的直接途径。然而，这种细化对于动态可观测量仍然很困难，因为微分混沌分子轨迹会产生不稳定的梯度。在这里，我们引入 PathGrad，它区分 Langevin 路径概率而不是轨迹本身。所得的梯度估计器是根据热噪声和力导数即时累积的，并且随着轨迹长度的增加，其方差保持稳定。我们根据有限差分计算验证了梯度估计器，并用它根据实验扩散系数和结构约束来微调熔融铜和水势。
abstract: arXiv:2611.32851v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning force fields inherit the errors of the electronic-structure methods used to generate their training data, and refining them against experimental measurements provides a direct route beyond this limit. However, such refinement remains difficult for dynamical observables because differentiating chaotic molecular trajectories yields unstable gradients. Here, we introduce PathGrad, which differentiates Langevin path probabilities instead of the trajectories themselves. The resulting gradient estimator is accumulated on the fly from thermal noise and force derivatives, and its variance remains stable as the trajectory length increases. We validated the gradient estimator against finite-difference calculations and used it to fine-tune molten-copper and water potentials against experimental diffusion coefficients together with structural constraints. For water, jointly optimizing diffusion and the oxygen-oxygen radial distribution function also improves the predictions of shear viscosity and rotational relaxation, neither of which is included in the optimization objective. Alignment at a single temperature also improves the apparent activation energies of multiple dynamical observables, bringing their temperature dependences closer to experiments. Moreover, the optimized potential exhibits smaller force errors relative to an independent, higher-level quantum-chemical reference, indicating that alignment with experiments improves the fidelity of the potential energy surface beyond the fitted targets. PathGrad thus establishes a general framework for incorporating experimental observables directly into force field optimizations.

title: Anharmonic enhancement of thermal conductivity in amorphous Ge₂Sb₂Te₅: A consistent picture from molecular dynamics and Wigner transport
title_zh: 非晶态 Ge2Sb2Te₅ 热导率的非谐增强：分子动力学和维格纳输运的一致图景
summary: 非谐性限制了晶体中的热传导，但它在非晶固体中的作用仍然不稳定，其中热量主要通过准简并振动之间的隧道传输。在这里，我们理清了结构无序、量子统计和非谐性对原型相变存储材料非晶 Ge2Sb2Te5 (aGST) 热导率的影响。使用在第一原理数据上训练的单个机器学习势，我们将经典平衡和非平衡分子动力学（MD）（包括所有阶的非调和性）与调和艾伦-费尔德曼理论和非调和维格纳输运方程（两者都包括量子统计）进行比较。
abstract: arXiv:2611.33089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anharmonicity limits heat conduction in crystals, but its role in amorphous solids, where heat is carried mainly by tunneling between quasi-degenerate vibrations, remains unsettled. Here we disentangle the contributions of structural disorder, quantum statistics, and anharmonicity to the thermal conductivity of amorphous Ge₂Sb₂Te₅ (aGST), the prototypical phase-change memory material. Using a single machine-learned potential trained on first-principles data, we compare classical equilibrium and nonequilibrium molecular dynamics (MD), which include anharmonicity to all orders, with harmonic Allen-Feldman theory and the anharmonic Wigner transport equation, both of which include quantum statistics. Four MD approaches agree on a conductivity of 0.171-0.181 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹ at room temperature, about 16% above the harmonic Allen-Feldman value for the same model, and the Wigner formulation bridges the two: with classical statistics, it agrees with MD to within 5%. We trace this anharmonic enhancement to vibrational couplings that grow with the frequency difference between modes, so that anharmonic broadening opens additional channels for heat conduction. A comparison with silica, alumina, and disordered carbons reveals three regimes, in which anharmonicity reduces, barely affects, or enhances the conductivity. The predicted glass-like increase of the conductivity with temperature is consistent with thermoreflectance measurements. These results show that anharmonicity has no universal effect in disordered solids, and can promote rather than limit heat transport in strongly disordered materials.

title: Atom as an Agent: Emergent Order by Collective Predictive Coding
title_zh: 原子作为代理：通过集体预测编码产生的秩序
summary: 微观系统中出现宏观序参数的内在原因是什么？在本文中，我们将集体预测编码（CPC），即语言/符号出现理论应用于物理学。正如我们的语言源于人类的交流，物理宏观秩序参数也源于原子之间的交流——每个原子都被视为一个通过推理来预测彼此行为的代理。我们提出了经典自旋系统的三个例子：二维铁磁和反铁磁 Ising 模型、具有竞争条纹顺序的二维自旋模型以及完全连接的 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 自旋玻璃模型。
abstract: arXiv:2610.36673v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: What is the intrinsic reason of emergence of macroscopic order parameter out of microscopic systems? In this article, we apply to physics the collective predictive coding (CPC), the theory of language/symbol emergence. As our language emerges out of our human communications, physical macroscopic order parameter emerges out of communications among atoms --- each atom is regarded as an agent who predicts each other's behavior through inference. We present three examples of classical spin systems: two-dimensional ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, a two-dimensional spin model with competing stripe orders, and the fully connected Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin-glass model. In all of these examples, proper macroscopic order parameters including the replica overlap emerge automatically through communication informatics of CPC, only from observed spin configurations. We call the learned macroscopic coordinate the collective predictive order. Furthermore, for the ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, the equilibrium distribution of the collective predictive order yields an emergent potential with the symmetry and thermal evolution characteristic of a Landau potential. Notably, the emergence of the collective predictive order does not refer to any structure of microscopic Hamiltonians/Lagrangians. Thus our ``Atom-as-an-Agent" (AaaA) principle offers a completely data-driven method for the emergence of macroscopic order, that is, machine learning physics.

title: Ground state and thermal phase diagrams of the magnetized spin-1/2 XXZ antiferromagnet on the triangular lattice
title_zh: 三角晶格上磁化自旋 1/2 XXZ 反铁磁体的基态和热相图
summary: 磁场中三角晶格上的自旋 1/2 XXZ 反铁磁体是典型的受挫量子磁体，但其一般各向异性的基态相图及其热相结构仍未完全了解。在这里，使用无限密度矩阵重整化群、无限投影纠缠对算子和指数张量重整化群方法，在精确对角化的支持下，我们解决了这两个问题。在零温度下，我们连续绘制从伊辛极限到海森堡点的相图，发现非经典 Ψ 超固体在所研究的所有各向异性下都是略低于饱和度的稳定相：它直接与强易轴区域中的三分之一磁化上下平台和朝向海森堡点的半经典 V 相接壤。
abstract: arXiv:2611.31412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 XXZ antiferromagnet on the triangular lattice in a magnetic field is a paradigmatic frustrated quantum magnet, yet its ground-state phase diagram at generic anisotropy and its thermal phase structure remain incompletely understood. Here, using infinite density-matrix renormalization group, infinite projected entangled-pair operator, and exponential tensor renormalization group methods, supported by exact diagonalization, we resolve both issues. At zero temperature, we map the phase diagram continuously from the Ising limit to the Heisenberg point and find that the nonclassical Ψ supersolid is a stable phase just below saturation at all anisotropies studied: it borders the one-third-magnetization up-up-down plateau directly in the strongly easy-axis regime and the semiclassical V phase toward the Heisenberg point. In the strongly easy-axis regime, we uncover an intrinsically finite-temperature bond-nematic phase above the zero-temperature plateau--Ψ boundary, in which the three bond directions become spontaneously inequivalent without transverse spin coherence or three-sublattice order. A hard-core-boson mapping reveals its origin: once thermal fluctuations destroy phase coherence, the field-doped holes settle on domain walls of the local up-up-down order, which are stabilized by quantum kink delocalization and aligned by its Z₃ registry. Our results call for reexamining high-field states in triangular-lattice cobaltates such as Na₂BaCo(PO₄)₂ and K₂Co(SeO₃)₂.

title: Intrinsic spin accumulation in the magnetic spin Hall effect
title_zh: 磁自旋霍尔效应中的本征自旋累积
summary: 磁自旋霍尔效应是一种时间反转奇数现象，其中充电电流感应自旋电流。然而，在存在自旋轨道耦合和/或非共线磁性的情况下，自旋流并不是唯一定义的。相反，我们研究自旋对电场梯度的固有响应，该电场梯度描述了磁系统边界处的自旋累积。我们推导了一个由布洛赫波函数表示的通用公式，并将其应用于代表性交流磁体 RuO2 和 MnF2 的最小模型。我们的结果表明，磁绝缘体中的本征自旋累积可以是非零的，与磁自旋霍尔电导率形成鲜明对比。
abstract: arXiv:2509.24719v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The magnetic spin Hall effect is a time-reversal-odd phenomenon in which spin current is induced by the charge current. In the presence of a spin-orbit coupling and/or noncolinear magnetism, however, spin current is not uniquely defined. Instead, we study an intrinsic response of spin to an electric field gradient that describes the spin accumulation at the boundaries of magnetic systems. We derive a generic formula expressed by Bloch wave functions and apply it to a minimal model for representative altermagnets, RuO₂ and MnF₂. Our results show that the intrinsic spin accumulation can be nonzero in magnetic insulators in sharp contrast to the magnetic spin Hall conductivity.

title: Magnetoelectric flat band induced by a sqrt3×sqrt3 charge density wave in monolayer CrSe₂
title_zh: 由单层CrSe₂中的sqrt3×sqrt3电荷密度波诱导的磁电平带
summary: 我们使用从头计算研究了 CrSe2 极性 sqrt3×sqrt3 电荷密度波 (CDW) 相的电子和磁性。 CDW 在范德华平面之外引入了极性畸变，该畸变耦合到自旋极化的 Cr d 态，从而在费米能级处产生非常平坦的电子能带。我们通过详细分析结构重建、轨道杂化的影响、晶体场分裂、自旋轨道耦合和电子相关性，提供了对平带起源的微观理解。我们的计算表明，由于 CDW 失真的极性性质，电场可以充当外部开关来诱发 CDW 相位，从而提供了一种操纵系统中强相关性的方法。
abstract: arXiv:2606.24494v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the electronic and magnetic properties of the polar sqrt3×sqrt3 charge-density-wave (CDW) phase of CrSe₂ using ab initio calculations. The CDW introduces a polar distortion out of the van der Waals plane that couples to the spin-polarized Cr d states resulting in a remarkably flat electronic band exactly at the Fermi level. We provide a microscopic understanding of the origin of the flat band by analyzing in detail the structural reconstruction, the effects of orbital hybridization, crystal-field splittings, spin-orbit coupling and electronic correlations. Our calculations show that due to the polar nature of the CDW distortion, an electric field can act as an external switch to induce the CDW phase, providing a way to manipulate strong correlations in the system.

title: Integration of Mott neurons and spintronic memories for event-driven spiking neural networks
title_zh: 事件驱动尖峰神经网络的莫特神经元和自旋电子记忆的集成
summary: 提出了一种混合计算和存储核心，将热耦合二氧化钒泄漏集成和激发神经元与域壁赛道存储器相结合。该架构保留了时间尖峰历史，并以低功耗实现了高识别精度。
abstract: Nature Nanotechnology, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41565-026-02311-0 A hybrid compute-and-store core combining thermally coupled vanadium dioxide leaky integrate-and-fire neurons with domain-wall racetrack memory is presented. This architecture preserves temporal spike histories and achieves high recognition accuracy with low power consumption.

title: Machine Learning Model for the Chemistry of a Solvated Electron
title_zh: 溶剂化电子化学的机器学习模型
summary: 作者：Ruiqi Taka、Pinchen Xie 和 Roberto Car 在分子模拟中，机器学习力场可以以较低的成本实现从头算的精度，但在电子的显式建模中仍然受到限制。在这封信中，我们开发了一种电子感知机器学习力场，其中多余的感兴趣电子被建模为量子力学……[物理。莱特牧师。 137, 228001] 2026 年 11 月 25 日星期三发布
abstract: Author(s): Ruiqi Gao, Pinchen Xie, and Roberto Car In molecular simulations, machine learning force fields can achieve ab initio accuracy at a lower cost but remain limited in the explicit modeling of electrons. In this Letter, we develop an electron-aware machine learning force field in which an excess electron of interest is modeled quantum mechan… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 228001] Published Wed Nov 25, 2026
